data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 344.778m. The syndicate reports net prior-year development during 2015 of a release of GBP 57.637m (net of reinsurance). This release reflects favourable claims experience particularly in casualty/global casualty segments. A gross prior-year movement figure was not explicitly presented in a single gross 'movement in prior year provision' line in the notes, so the quantified PYD used here is the net movement disclosed in the movement table.

data.data_quality_notes: The report does not present a single explicit GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure in the notes. The claims movement table available (Note 8) provides the movement in the past year's provision NET of reinsurance (total net release GBP 57.637k). A gross PYD figure could not be unambiguously extracted from the technical reserves reconciliation or triangle within the time available, so the net figure has been used as a fallback. Users should note this is NET of reinsurance. The gross claims development triangle is present (see page 39) but mapping its diagonals to compute a consolidated gross PYD would require detailed cell-level reconciliation and excluding 'and prior' aggregates; this was not used as primary here.
